high_level_description: This image depicts a futuristic and surreal scene featuring a large, pyramid-shaped structure floating above the clouds. The pyramid is composed of multiple layers, each illuminated with warm, golden lights that give it an ethereal glow. The top layer has a circular opening, possibly a window or a portal, which adds to the mysterious and otherworldly atmosphere. Surrounding the pyramid are several smaller, sleek spacecraft, some of which appear to be engaged in combat or maneuvering around the structure. These ships emit trails of light, suggesting they are moving at high speeds.
